paragraphs: Rav Dimi bar Nechemyah, son of Rav Yosef. In Sanhedrin 23b, 24a the reading is “son of Rav Nachman, son of Rav Yosef.” Perhaps the reading before Yuchasin was “bar Nechemyah bar Yosef,” for Rabbi Nechemyah bar Yosef is mentioned many times in the Talmud. But it requires examination why he brings Rav Nachman bar Yosef.
